description: This file contains the implementation of the MixerFragment class, which manages a user interface for audio mixing, including track control, effects toggling, and interaction with a playback service.

classes.name: MixerFragment
classes.description: A Fragment providing a UI for audio mixing controls, handling user interactions and communicating with a playback service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes fragment result listeners for deck loading and effect addition.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes view components, sets up event listeners, and prepares the playback connector.

methods.name: toggleEcho
methods.description: Toggles the echo switch state programmatically.

methods.name: simpleChange
methods.description: Helper to create a SeekBar change listener that triggers a callback with the new value.
